commands.review_summary:
The PR adds retry-without-dimensions and a per-client circuit breaker for OpenAI-compatible embeddings, rejects mismatched fallback vector widths, and lets optional non-local memory providers degrade to FTS-only fallback after persistent failures.

PR surface: Source +112, Tests +162. Total +274 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the current PR blockers: the CI check-lint log reproduces three changed-file lint errors on the PR head. The canonical WSL2 memory-index hang was not live-reproduced in this read-only review, but the linked issue and PR proof map it to the inspected provider path.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] The remaining blocker is a narrow mechanical repair in changed provider/test files; no maintainer product decision is needed for that cleanup.

target.title: [AI] fix(embedding): retry without dimensions and degrade non-local providers on persistent failure
target.body:
## Summary

Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible embedding servers (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, TGI, Alibaba) that reject the OpenAI `dimensions` parameter caused memory indexing to hang indefinitely in an infinite retry loop. Non-local embedding providers also lacked a degradation path, preventing FTS-only fallback.

- Problem: `postEmbeddingRequest` always sends `dimensions` when configured → self-hosted servers reject/reset → infinite retry loop (3 retries × batch splitting) with no graceful exit. `markLocalEmbeddingProviderDegraded` only handles `provider.id === "local"`, so non-local providers never enter FTS fallback.
- Solution: (1) Retry without `dimensions` after HTTP 4xx rejection or connection reset, with per-client circuit breaker to skip dimensions on subsequent requests. (2) Extend provider degradation to non-local providers in optional mode, allowing FTS-only fallback while preserving fail-closed for explicitly required providers.
- What changed: `src/plugins/openai-compatible-embedding-provider.ts` (+86/-34 — dimensions retry + circuit breaker), `extensions/memory-core/src/memory/manager.ts` (+40/-8 — non-local provider degradation), `src/plugins/openai-compatible-embedding-provider.test.ts` (+57/-0 — dimensions retry test)
- What did NOT change: Local provider degradation path, retry parameters, timeout durations, cache identity computation, required-mode provider fail-closed contract, batch logging (already in main via #94732)

## Change Type (select all)

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope (select all)

- [ ] Gateway / orchestration
- [ ] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [x] Memory / storage
- [ ] Integrations
- [ ] API / contracts
- [ ] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- Related to #93312
- [x] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Motivation

When `memorySearch.provider` is set to `openai-compatible` with `outputDimensionality` pointing at a self-hosted embedding server (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, TGI, Alibaba DashScope, etc.), the server typically rejects the OpenAI-specific `dimensions` parameter with HTTP 400 or resets the connection. Since `postEmbeddingRequest` always includes `dimensions`, every retry fails identically. The outer `runMemoryEmbeddingBatchRetryWithSplit` retries 3 times with exponential backoff, then recursively halves and retries — all with the same failing payload. The process loops until killed by SIGKILL.

Even after retries are exhausted, `markLocalEmbeddingProviderDegraded` gates on `provider.id === "local"` and returns immediately for non-local providers. The sync error handler's graceful FTS-only path requires `!this.provider`, which never becomes true, so the error is re-thrown and the retry cycle continues.

This fix addresses both issues: the root cause (dimensions rejection) and the safety net (non-local degradation).

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

**Behavior addressed**: openai-compatible memory embedding against self-hosted servers that reject the OpenAI `dimensions` parameter. Batch embedding sends dimensions first, gets HTTP 400, retries without dimensions, and succeeds. Circuit breaker then prevents subsequent requests from wasting an attempt on the same client. Non-local optional providers degrade after persistent failures instead of looping.

**Real environment tested**: Linux 4.19.112-2.el8 x86_64, Node v24.13.1, OpenClaw main branch at f3106057e6, branch fix/embedding-dimensions-degrade-93312.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

```
node --import tsx /tmp/proof-93312-dimensions-retry.mjs
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/openai-compatible-embedding-provider.test.ts --run
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/src/memory/embeddings.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/memory/manager-embedding-timeout.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/memory/manager-embedding-policy.test.ts --run
```

**Evidence after fix**:

```console
$ node --import tsx /tmp/proof-93312-dimensions-retry.mjs
============================================================
  Real behavior proof: openai-compatible dimensions retry
  Simulated self-hosted llama.cpp / Ollama server
============================================================
Date:       2026-07-07T02:08:31.437Z
Runtime:    Node.js v24.13.1
Server:     http://127.0.0.1:45595/v1
Config:     provider=openai-compatible model=bge-m3.gguf outputDimensionality=1024
Server:     HTTP 400 on 'dimensions', 200 without

Provider:   id=openai-compatible model=bge-m3.gguf dims=1024
Cache key:  dimensions in identity = true

--- Batch embedding (3 documents) ---
Vectors:    3 (dim 3)
[25, 27, 13]

--- Query embedding ---
Vector:     [21, 22, 23]

--- Server request log ---
  #1: batch hasDims=true n=3 → 400→retry (rejected: dims unsupported)
  #2: batch hasDims=false n=3 → 200✓ (retry without dims)
  #3: query hasDims=false n=1 → 200✓ (circuit breaker)

--- Verification ---
  [PASS] Batch sends dimensions first
  [PASS] Batch retries without dimensions (400→200)
  [PASS] Circuit breaker: query skips dimensions
  [PASS] Circuit breaker: query returns 3-dim vector
  [PASS] Batch returns 3 vectors
  [PASS] Cache includes dimensions regardless of wire
  [PASS] Exactly 3 requests total (batch 400+200, query 200)
  [PASS] All responses successful (no errors)

ALL 8 CHECKS PASSED
============================================================
```

Dimensions retry behavior matrix:

```
Request sequence                    => Result
Batch request with dimensions       => HTTP 400 → retry without dimensions → HTTP 200
Query request (after circuit breaker) => skips dimensions → HTTP 200 (1 request, not 2)
Cache identity                      => includes dimensions regardless of wire behavior
```

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/openai-compatible-embedding-provider.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  27 passed (27)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/src/memory/embeddings.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/memory/manager-embedding-timeout.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/memory/manager-embedding-policy.test.ts --run
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  37 passed (37)
```

**Observed result after fix**:
1. Production `postEmbeddingRequest` sends `dimensions` on first attempt (compatible endpoints unchanged)
2. On HTTP 400 with "Unrecognized request parameter: dimensions", retries without dimensions and succeeds
3. Circuit breaker (WeakSet) prevents subsequent requests from sending dimensions to the same client
4. Provider identity (`dimensions` in `cacheKeyData`) preserved regardless of wire retry
5. Non-local optional providers (auto, local transport) degrade after persistent failures, enabling FTS-only fallback
6. Required providers (explicitly configured non-local) preserve fail-closed semantics
7. 64 tests pass (27 + 37), 8/8 proof checks pass

**What was not tested**: Live llama.cpp GPU server with BGE-M3 model (requires Intel Arc A770 not available in this environment). Alibaba Cloud text-embedding-v3 end-to-end (requires cloud credentials). Full multi-file memory index of 665 workspace files (requires full OpenClaw workspace + GPU server). The unit tests cover the exact code paths from the bug report; the proof script validates the retry + circuit breaker behavior with a real HTTP server on the production provider-adapter code path.

## Root Cause (if applicable)

**Cause 1 — dimensions always sent**: `postEmbeddingRequest` (openai-compatible-embedding-provider.ts:356) unconditionally includes `dimensions` when configured, with no retry-without path. Introduced by PR #85269 (dutifulbob) which added the OpenAI-compatible embedding provider. Made visible by user reports with self-hosted llama.cpp/Ollama endpoints that reject unknown parameters.

**Cause 2 — non-local degradation missing**: `markLocalEmbeddingProviderDegraded` (manager.ts:516) gates on `this.provider?.id !== "local"` and returns early for all non-local providers. The sync error handler (manager-sync-ops.ts:2582) requires `!this.provider` for graceful FTS-only exit, which never becomes true for non-local providers.

**Confidence**: clear — both causes are confirmed by source inspection of current main (f3106057e6).

## Regression Test Plan

- Target: `src/plugins/openai-compatible-embedding-provider.test.ts` (27 tests), `extensions/memory-core/src/memory/embeddings.test.ts`, `manager-embedding-timeout.test.ts`, `manager-embedding-policy.test.ts` (37 tests)
- New test "retries without dimensions when the server rejects the parameter" validates: dimensions sent first → 400 → retry without dimensions → success; circuit breaker on subsequent requests; provider identity preserved
- Existing local-provider degradation tests unchanged
- 64 total tests pass, 0 regressions

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

None by default. Self-hosted embedding endpoints that previously hung will now complete successfully. The dimensions retry is transparent — compatible endpoints still receive dimensions on the first request. The only observable change is that previously-hanging memory indexes now complete.

## Security Impact (required)

- [x] New permissions/capabilities? No
- [x] Secrets/tokens handling changed? No
- [x] New/changed network calls? No (same endpoint, retry without one JSON field)
- [x] Command/tool execution surface changed? No
- [x] Data access scope changed? No

## Human Verification (required)

- Verified scenarios: Real HTTP server simulating llama.cpp dimensions rejection → retry → success; circuit breaker prevents second dimensions attempt; cache identity preserved; existing local provider degradation unchanged
- Edge cases checked: Dimensions configured but not in circuit breaker → sent first; already in circuit breaker → skipped; no dimensions configured → no retry needed; signal aborted → no retry; required-mode provider → no degradation
- What you did NOT verify: Live GPU-powered llama.cpp with BGE-M3; full workspace memory index of 665 files end-to-end; provider close() side effects after non-local degradation

## Compatibility / Migration

- [x] Backward compatible? Yes (compatible endpoints still receive dimensions; incompatible endpoints now succeed instead of hanging)
- [x] Config/env changes? No
- [x] Migration needed? No

## Best-fix Verdict

- **Best fix**: Yes — The dimensions retry is at the right boundary (provider adapter handles endpoint compatibility). The degradation extension is at the right boundary (memory manager owns provider lifecycle). Both follow existing patterns: the retry is modeled on the outer `runMemoryEmbeddingBatchRetryWithSplit`; the degradation reuses the existing `createDegradedMemoryProviderLifecycle` infrastructure.
- **Refactor needed**: No — The embedding provider architecture already has the degraded/lifecycle infrastructure; we simply close two gaps (no dimensions retry, no non-local degradation).
- **Alternative considered**: (1) Remove dimensions entirely — would break compatible endpoints that produce the correct output dimensionality. (2) Add a config flag per provider — unnecessary complexity; circuit breaker handles this transparently. (3) Broader approach with committed proof script — the proof script in repository adds unnecessary surface; we keep proof external.

## AI Assistance 🤖

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **AI model**: deepseek-v4-pro
- **Human confirmed understanding of code changes**: Yes

## Risks and Mitigations

**Highest-risk area**: The dimensions retry could mask genuinely misconfigured endpoints — if a server rejects dimensions for a reason other than parameter incompatibility, the retry might succeed silently with wrong-dimensionality vectors.

**Mitigations**:
- Retry is capped at 1 per request (the outer memory embedding retry loop provides independent exponential backoff with `maxAttempts=3`)
- Circuit breaker is per-client, per-process (WeakSet) — no persistent state, resets on restart
- Error detection regex covers 6+ provider families with conservative matching
- AbortSignal propagation ensures caller cancellation wins
- Required-mode providers still fail-closed (no silent degradation)

**Compatibility impact**: No breaking changes. Compatible endpoints receive dimensions as before. Incompatible endpoints now succeed instead of hanging. Existing configurations work without modification.

---

Related to #93312
